description: Telecommunications market data tables is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ofcom. This quarterly dataset for the UK fixed-line and mobile telecommunication markets contains data for aggregated call revenues, mobile phone and landline connections, call volumes, message volumes and subscriber numbers. The tables are published quarterly on the Ofcom website in pdf and csv formats. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Ofcom. It offers 24 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2020-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
